The '''Galdronia system''' was a part of the [[Arrowhead]] region, in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with the work ''[[Beneath The Galdronian Moon: A Modern Lover's Epic]]''.<ref name="Galladinium">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Galdronia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-10.<ref name="TEA" />
